title: Arst
description: The house is a four-bedroom dwelling with an office, developed on a single floor. It also includes a suite with a walk-in closet. The design responds to the specific characteristics of the plot, which is very narrow and elongated. The formal and spatial solution takes the shape of a semi-L configuration in its volumetric expression. This layout allows for an organization of spaces where all rooms benefit from similar qualities of natural light and living comfort.
